title: Banished To The Nether
description: Nether ban, ban people to the nether
body:
# NetherBan

When a player gets in trouble NetherBan does not kick them out of the server. It sends them to the Nether instead.

NetherBan takes the player to a spot deep in the Nether. It also stops them from using portals teleporting or going to their homes and other safe places. When the time is up the player goes back to where they were

This is great for lots of servers like SMPs, hardcore servers, prisons, factions and custom punishment systems.

---

## Features

* We can choose how long the player stays in the Nether it can be for a while or forever.

* The player goes to a random spot in the Nether each time.

* They cannot use commands to get out.

* They cannot use the Nether portal to escape.

* When the time is up the player goes back, to where they were.

* We can change the messages and settings to what we want.

* NetherBan does not slow down the server.

---

## Commands

```text id="5r5q6j"

/netherban <player> <time>

/unnetherban <player>

/netherbancheck <player>

/netherbanreload

```

---

## Permissions

```text id="lr4yqt"

netherban.admin

netherban.ban

netherban.unban

netherban.reload

```

---

## Configuration Example

```yaml id="jlwm3n"

nether-border-radius: 5000

min-teleport-distance: 1000

teleport-y-level: 70

blocked-commands:

Spawn

Home

Warp

Tp

Teleport

Tpa

Back

Rtp

```

---

## Supported Platforms

* Paper

* Spigot

* Purpur

## Supported Versions

* 1.20 and higher

* We recommend using 1.21 or higher

---

## Punishment Reimagined

NetherBan does not just kick players out of the server. It makes them survive in the Nether until their time is up. This is a way to handle players who get in trouble. NetherBan is a way to punish players. NetherBan makes the game more fun.
